summary: Owner requested a granular opt-in agentic search track and implementation of its first saved archive slice. Ordinary search must remain the default.
Traced indexed revision retrieval, visibility policy and the existing offline model adapter on main. Reproduced cited ordinary retrieval on a synthetic saved document using Python 3.15.2.

Python 3.15.2 baseline passed with 371 Python tests and 12 skips, 19 station tests, and 96 Node tests. The final 19 focused tests, compile checks, CLI help and leak gate passed. The module CLI executed a checksum-pinned fixture planner, recovered the expected saved revision and preserved the database SHA-256.

Two independent reviews confirmed lazy opt-in, current eligibility, read-only lookup, original citations and failure outcomes. Added the roadmap link to task ownership and retained an explicit outcome for a malformed model manifest.

Implemented the saved-catalogue CLI and verified ordinary search, one opt-in local rewrite, restricted revisions and fallback. Hosted acceptance is recorded in the pull request. T2 and T3 remain planned.
